data.name: Force Bomb*
data.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it inflict force damage. Force bombs deal %1d%2 points of force damage instead of the normal damage for a bomb. Creatures that take a direct hit from a force bomb are knocked prone unless they succeed on a Reflex save.|AlchemistBombAdditionalDice+1|ForceBombDieSize
